selectedKey is user selection. Once the fetched catalog exists, an absent selected bundle invalidates that key so it cannot silently reappear as selected in a later catalog. The tests exercise refreshed catalog and import selection; the missing-key guard is source evidence.

selected is a lookup of selectedKey in libraryQuery.data, not another effect-produced state. Clearing a missing key converges to null; it does not enqueue a selection chain. The refreshed-index scenario supplies the real external data transition.

Query completion and removal of a previously selected key are not tied to one UI event. The query is also declaratively gated by enabled; remote synchronization itself is an explicit action. The library tests check no remote refresh on initial load and a request after clicking Refresh.

The library owns one local bundle catalog, per-operation pending keys and selection. Import confirmation is delegated to the bundle import flow. Tests distinguish local load from explicit remote refresh, isolate pending rows and inspect the selected import version.
